name: giveaway-promotion-plan
title_zh: 抽奖没人来？按渠道排好日程的推广总表
tagline_zh: 不是发两条帖子就完事。它把邮件序列、达人简报、付费推流排成一张表，连开奖后复用哪条内容都替你标好。
tagline_en: Not just two posts. It schedules emails, creator briefs, paid boosts, and even what to reuse after winners are.
desc_en: Plan how a giveaway gets seen: channel-by-channel schedule, post and story templates, the email sequence (launch, mid, last call, winners), partner and creator briefs, paid boosts, and what to reuse afterwards. Use when the user asks 'how do I promote my giveaway', 'nobody is entering', 'promotion plan', 'launch posts', 'giveaway email sequence', 'what do I email people who entered', 'partner brie
why_zh: 把散落的推广动作收编成一条时间线，每个渠道该说什么、隔几天追一次，全按节奏走，不用你边发边想下一步。
why_en: Turns scattered promo actions into one timeline—what to say per channel, when to follow up, all sequenced so you never improvise.
limit_zh: 只覆盖抽奖推广的规划与文案模板，不碰奖品设置、抽奖工具选型或合规条款；邮件序列止步于开奖通知，不包含后续营销自动化。
limit_en: Covers promo planning & copy templates only. No prize setup, tool selection, or legal compliance. Email sequence ends at winner notice—no marketing.
